## Load a fit

```{r}
patient <- 0
window  <- "first_cycle" # first_cycle, two_cycles or full_history
fit <- readRDS(here::here(sprintf("fits/synth_switchable/%s/fit_patient%03d.rds", window, patient)))
params <- c("cost", "turnover", "n0", "rFrac", "rS", "dD", "sigma")
```

## Parameter recovery

Made by `R/plot_synth_switchable.R`.

```{r, out.width = "100%"}
knitr::include_graphics(here::here(sprintf("fits/synth_switchable/results/recovery_%s.png", params)))
```

## Observations and true trajectory

```{r}
#all observations, flagged by whether they were in the fitted window
obs <- load_synth_patient(patient) |>
  filter(!is.na(PSA)) |>
  mutate(fitted  = CycleId <= synth_windows[[window]],
         PSA_rel = PSA / first(PSA)) #relative to the first observation
#noise-free ODE solution the observations were simulated from
trajectory <- read_csv(here::here(sprintf("synth_data/patient_%d_ODEdf.csv", patient)),
                       show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "unique_quiet") |>
  select(Time, DrugConcentration, S, R, TumourSize)
initial_size <- trajectory$TumourSize[1]

trajectory |>
  pivot_longer(c(S, R, TumourSize), names_to = "population") |>
  ggplot(aes(Time, value / initial_size)) +
  geom_line(aes(colour = population)) +
  geom_point(data = obs, aes(Time, PSA_rel, shape = fitted)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1)) +
  labs(y = "Tumour size relative to initial", shape = "In fitted window")
```

## Predicted trajectory: first cycle vs two cycles

Posterior draws from each fit are run through Kit Gallagher's python simulator on the patient's actual treatment schedule.

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 4.5}
pacman::p_load(reticulate)
use_virtualenv("/Users/80002536/Documents/moffitt/at-modelling/.venv", required = TRUE)
source_python(here::here("python/forward_sim.py"))

schedule <- build_treatment_schedule(trajectory)
n_draws  <- 200

#same parameterisation as stan/model_switchable.stan
simulate_draw <- function(cost, turnover, n0, rFrac, rS, dD, K, ...) {
  run_forward_sim(list(rS = rS, rR = (1 - cost) * rS, dS = turnover * rS, dR = turnover * rS, dD = dD, K = K,
                       S0 = (1 - rFrac) * n0, R0 = rFrac * n0, DMax = 1), schedule, dt = 1) |>
    select(Time, TumourSize) |>
    mutate(TumourSize = TumourSize / first(TumourSize)) #relative to this draw's initial size
}

set.seed(1)
predictions <- map_dfr(c("first_cycle", "two_cycles"), \(w) {
  draws <- readRDS(here::here(sprintf("fits/synth_switchable/%s/fit_patient%03d.rds", w, patient)))$draws(
    c(params, "K"), format = "draws_df") |>
    as_tibble() |>
    slice_sample(n = n_draws)
  draws |>
    mutate(sim = pmap(draws, simulate_draw)) |>
    select(sim) |>
    unnest(sim) |>
    group_by(Time) |>
    summarise(median = median(TumourSize), lower = quantile(TumourSize, .1), upper = quantile(TumourSize, .9)) |>
    mutate(window = w)
})


```

```{r}
#observations flagged by whether each fit saw them
obs_by_window <- map_dfr(c("first_cycle", "two_cycles"), \(w) mutate(obs, window = w, fitted = CycleId <= synth_windows[[w]]))
#predictions start after the last observation each fit saw
prediction_start <- obs_by_window |> filter(fitted) |> group_by(window) |> summarise(Time = max(Time))

ggplot(predictions, aes(Time)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = .3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median),  linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(data = trajectory, aes(y = TumourSize / initial_size)) +
  geom_vline(data = prediction_start, aes(xintercept = Time), linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 1.2), linetype = "dotted") +
  #geom_point(data = obs_by_window, aes(y = PSA_rel, shape = fitted)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ window) +
  labs(y = "Tumour burden relative to initial")
```
